title: A Jurassic mammaliaform swimmer and transformation of the mammalian pharynx
title_zh: 侏罗纪哺乳形类游泳者与哺乳咽部的转化
abstract: The discovery of a well-preserved mammaliaform fossil from the Middle Jurassic period of China reveals evidence on the evolutionary transformation of the feeding apparatus and the ecological diversity of Mesozoic era mammals. Mammaliaforms are evolutionary predecessors to modern Mammalia1-3, and their morphologies provide primary insights into the evolutionary origin of mammals. The rare preservation of a therian-like pharyngeal vault (throat passage) and hyoid skeletal anatomy (throat bones) in this mammaliaform suggests that critical soft-tissue anatomy for therian-like swallowing, drinking and suckling behaviours had evolved in the common ancestors of Docodonta and Mammalia, long before the rise of modern mammals. This fossil exhibits a wealth of features specialized for swimming, filling in a major gap of anatomical knowledge of pelvis and hindlimb for early mammals. It is characterized by highly distinctive canines and pseudo-carnassial sectorial teeth for a faunivorous diet. We interpret that this mammaliaform was semiaquatic, swimming and foraging in water, with a lifestyle analogous to the extant platypus. This species is the largest of Jurassic mammaliaforms. It expands the body size range of docodontans, and adds to a growing body of evidence that multiple docodontans exploited diverse niches with semiaquatic and other ecomorphotypes. Docodontans are an early example of replicated evolution of the semiaquatic and other ecomorphotypes in the Mesozoic ecosystem dominated by dinosaurs, long before the diversification of extant mammals.
abstract_zh: 来自中国中侏罗纪的完整保存哺乳形类化石的发现，揭示了进食器官的进化转化以及中生代哺乳动物的生态多样性。哺乳形类是现代哺乳动物的进化前身，其形态为哺乳动物进化的起源提供了主要见解。该哺乳形类稀有的保存了类似有兽类的咽腔（喉道）和舌骨骨骼解剖结构，表明负责有兽类吞咽、饮水和吸奶行为的软组织解剖结构在有齿目和哺乳动物的共同祖先中进化，远早于现代哺乳动物的出现。该化石展示了大量适应游泳的特征，填补了早期哺乳动物骨盆和后肢的主要解剖知识空白。它具有高度独特的尖牙和假食肉齿切节牙，适应食肉饮食。我们认为，该哺乳形类是半水生的，在水中游动和觅食，其生活方式类似于现代鸭嘴兽。该物种是侏罗纪哺乳形类中体型最大的。它扩大了齿兽类的体型范围，并为证据库增加了多个齿兽类利用半水生和其他生态形态占据不同生态位的迹象。齿兽类是中生态系统中半水生和其他生态形态反复进化的早期例子，当时生态系统以恐龙为主，在现代哺乳动物的辐射之前。
